fields.summary_ko.0: Micron (NASDAQ:MU) rose 175% from early 2026 but fell 35% from June peak, with median Wall Street analyst price target at $1,575 (55 analysts), implying 107% upside from current price of $760.
fields.summary_ko.1: DRAM and NAND contract prices are expected to surge 4-fold this year and revenue jumped 379% to $54.4 billion in Q4, but concerns over oversupply persist due to cyclical nature of semiconductor industry.
